findings.highlight: It tries to eat abundantly and greedily, without the slightest opening.
findings.evidenceJa: 夥しく貪欲に、一部の隙もなく網羅しようと捕獲する
findings.governingReading: the black fingers capture him profusely and greedily, trying to encompass everything without the smallest gap
findings.explanation: Envelopment and capture are turned into literal eating, while the effort to cover every part disappears.

findings.highlight: It reinforces and embraces me, carefully and without exception.
findings.evidenceJa: 一部の開きもなく抱擁しようと補強する
findings.governingReading: it reinforces the enclosure so as to embrace him without leaving any opening
findings.explanation: A spatially gapless embrace becomes the logically vague “without exception,” and the purpose relation is flattened.
Loss of the whole individual self is narrowed to a change in bodily color.
